MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 Load CLIP (the model that looks at your pictures)

Download qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors9.35 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

Qwen3-VL 8B is a language model that can see. It reads each picture and writes the text. If you already have it from the Qwen Image 2.1 workflows, it is the same file.

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma, version 1.4.183 or newer. A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

A folder full of IMG_4031.jpg and ComfyUI_00412_.png? This looks at every picture and saves a copy under a name that says what is in it, like Golden Retriever Puppy in Yellow Raincoat.png, in one Run.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Old Pictures inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 What you get

  • A renamed copy of every picture in ComfyUI/output/Named by AI. The originals stay as they are.
  • A list of old and new names in the same folder, and in the Save Text Pixaroma box.

 Other kinds of names

  • The instruction is the formula, in the gear of AI Prompt Pixaroma. Ask for names in another language, all lower case with dashes for a website (golden-retriever-puppy), or the main colour first.
  • Keep the answer SHORT in the formula: a name longer than 100 letters is cut.

 Pictures with names are much easier to find later in Windows search, in Load Images from Folder, and on a website, where the file name also helps search engines.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved What AI Prompt needs Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 8B, looks at the pictures) - Qwen3-VL 8B, a language model that can SEE. It looks at each picture and names it. It runs on your own PC, nothing is sent online.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your pictures) - Point it at the folder you want to rename and pick the pictures. Press Run once and it sends every picture through, one after the other.
  • AI Prompt Pixaroma (2. writes a name for each picture) - Shows each picture to Qwen3-VL with the instruction in its formula (the gear): a 3 to 6 word name of what is in it. Its answer goes to Save Image as the file name.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs: count, pick, join or pass things along.

  • Text Join Two Pixaroma (old name and new name) - Joins the old name and the new one, like 01_Puppy > Golden Retriever Puppy in Yellow Raincoat, for the list.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (each picture under its new name) - Saves a copy of each picture under its new name into ComfyUI/output/Named by AI. Your original files are not touched. Two pictures that get the same name are both kept: the second gets _001 at the end.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Save Text Pixaroma (the list of old and new names) - The list of every old name next to its new name, on the node and in ComfyUI/output/Named by AI/names_001.txt, so you can always find which picture was which.
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
Loading Qwen3-VL the first timeabout 2 s more
Each nameunder 1 s
6 pictures (the demo)about 6 s

Qwen3-VL 8B needs about 10 GB of video memory. On a smaller card ComfyUI moves part of it to the computer's memory: it still works, slower.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • The AI text step took about 2 times as long.
